top_signals.title: Saudi oil production rebounds close to prewar levels
top_signals.summary: Output higher than average before Iran conflict as kingdom keeps exports flowing despite attacks on shipping and energy infrastructure
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Funds Warn Brazil $126 Billion Stock Market Rout Isn’t Over Yet
top_signals.summary: The rout in Brazilian assets sparked by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s re-election shows little sign of abating, with some of the nation’s biggest money managers saying a downturn that has already wiped out months of gains could get even worse.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Country’s Council of Economic Experts says military spending should be gradually funded by the regular budget to prevent debt hitting 98% of GDP by 2040
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Şahap Kavcıoğlu, who previously ran the central bank, tendered his resignation ‘to prevent any further damage’ to the regulator
